description: This file defines an Android Fragment class named LogFragment that contains a custom LogView for displaying log messages, manages layout and padding, and handles text change events to scroll to the bottom of the log.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that hosts a LogView widget and manages its display and behavior, including layout initialization and auto-scrolling behavior after text changes.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes the layout by creating a ScrollView containing a LogView, sets layout parameters, styling, padding, and gravity.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's onCreateView to set up the view hierarchy, attach a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the log to the bottom when text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
